171.DSCR:
The VF-27gamma in Fighter Mode, equipped with the Super Pack.
A machine based on the YF-24 Evolution with improved performance, it has limits that can withstand even high G forces. It also adopts a brain-wave control system for controlling the craft, among other features, and is designed on the premise of use by cyborg soldiers.

172.DSCR:
The VF-27gamma in Battroid Mode, equipped with the Super Pack.
Its greatest armament, the beam gun pod, is cutting-edge equipment that also functions as a beam grenade. It is a weapon so enormous that it is not much different from the Battroid form's full height, but its power is correspondingly tremendous.

175.DSCR:
A small trooper-type $$バジュラ$$.
The most numerous of the $$バジュラ$$, it mainly acts in the company of larger $$バジュラ$$.
It has high mobility, and although it has no wings, it can fly even within the atmosphere. It is also capable of biological Fold navigation, albeit only over short distances.
It attacks using pulse beams fired from the crystalline structure of its torso, as well as its anchor-shaped head and whip-like tail.

177.DSCR:
A large trooper-type $$バジュラ$$.
Each swarm numbers anywhere from several thousand to tens of thousands of individuals.
The ram-like protrusion on its back is a bio heavy beam cannon, and the high-output energy it fires rivals that of a space cruiser. It also has an outer shell of energy conversion armor, giving it excellent defensive ability.
It is also agile in its movements, using wing-like organs to operate both in space and within the atmosphere. It is likewise capable of biological Fold navigation over short distances.

179.DSCR:
A type of $$バジュラ$$, also known as the Hound $$バジュラ$$.
A rare species with fewer individuals compared to other $$バジュラ$$. It performs a commander-like role and carries out reconnaissance in force. Despite being a large individual, its wings give it extremely high flight ability within the atmosphere.
It fights using a bio heavy beam cannon, biological micro-missiles with tracking capability, and the enormous scythes on its forearms.

180.DSCR:
A type of $$バジュラ$$. The largest individual among the combat types.
The bio heavy beam cannon on its back has power comparable to the main gun of a space cruiser.
It has the role of guarding the nest.

It has the role of guarding the nest.

183.DSCR:
A $$バジュラ$$ that serves as the flagship within a combat group.
Each group numbers around ten to twenty individuals.
On the battlefield, countless large and small $$バジュラ$$ deploy around it to serve as its escort.
The triple bio heavy quantum beam cannon on its back and elsewhere is extremely powerful, with output rivaling that of a Macross Cannon. It is also equipped with bio energy conversion armor and a field barrier, giving it formidable defensive strength.
It is capable of biological Fold navigation, allowing it to travel across extremely long distances.

185.DSCR:

It is about the same size as the $$マクロス・クォーター$$, but has high mobility, and travels extremely long distances via biological Fold navigation.

186.DSCR:
The form created by bringing the $$女王バジュラ$$ under control through $$インプラント|lc$$ technology and fusing it with the $$バトル・フロンティア$$.
Its strange appearance was entirely covered by something like green vines, and the combined combat abilities of the $$バジュラ$$ and the $$バトル・フロンティア$$ brought out tremendous combat power.

195.DSCR:
An $$インベーダー#robot$$ that appeared near Jupiter.
It was large enough to swallow $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ whole, and did not even flinch when struck by a Getter Beam fired from inside it.
It was destroyed from the inside by the drill of $$真ゲッターライガー$$.

196.DSCR:
The form in which $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$ revealed their true nature as $$インベーダー#robot$$s and achieved the ultimate combination and fusion. It emerged from Jupiter, which had been turned into a Getter sun.
Not only did it spew out countless giant $$インベーダー#robot$$s, it also fired a powerful beam by making use of the moons Io, Callisto, and Europa, driving $$竜馬$$ and the others into a corner.
In the end, it was cut in two, along with the moons, by the Final Getter Tomahawk, which combined the power of $$真ゲッター$$ and $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$.

197.DSCR:
A super robot piloted by $$兜甲児$$.
It was built by his grandfather, $$兜十蔵$$, is powered by the mysterious super-energy known as photon power, and is armored in Super Alloy Z.
Its cockpit is the small, independently-mobile $$ホバーパイルダー$$, which combines with $$マジンガーＺ$$'s head at the command 'Pilder On!'
Its form calls to mind the image of a god that $$甲児$$ once saw depicted in a book in $$十蔵$$'s study, and when $$甲児$$ first laid eyes on it, its image overlapped with that of a giant golden god.
With overwhelming power, sturdy defenses, and powerful weaponry equipped all over its body, it battled the $$機械獣$$s sent by $$Ｄｒ．ヘル$$.
This is $$マジンガーＺ$$ equipped with $$ゴッドスクランダー$$, the final and strongest wings that $$十蔵$$ built from the Arm of $$ゼウス$$ brought back from $$バードス島$$. When $$マジンガーＺ$$ fell into crisis during the battle with $$エネルガーＺ$$, it appeared as if in answer to $$つばさ$$ calling out its name.
Once combined, $$マジンガーＺ$$ not only sees its flight speed and defensive power dramatically improved, but also gains the ability to unleash its ultimate move, Big Bang Punch, transforming itself into a giant fist to deliver a body blow.
Fighting alongside countless Rocket Punches, it defeated $$Ｄｒ．ヘル$$ with the Hundred-Shot Rocket Punch, but what awaited it afterward was the worst possible turn of events.

207.DSCR:
One of the Three Great Gods of $$ミケーネ$$, a god among gods.
Long ago, he rebelled against the gods of $$ミケーネ$$ to protect humanity.
In battle, his body's armor shines gold. The weapon he wields changes freely, normally a sword but sometimes transforming into a spear. The letter 'Z' is also engraved on his sword and forehead.
$$甲児$$, $$つばさ$$, and $$あしゅら男爵$$ encountered him when they were sent into ancient $$ミケーネ$$, the world of $$ケドラ$$'s memories.
Caught off guard by a scheme, he had his right arm cut off by $$ハーデス$$, but by fighting alongside $$マジンガーＺ$$, he drove $$ハーデス$$ back. The severed right arm turned into Japanium ore, and was left underground on $$バードス島$$ as the source of Super Alloy Z and photon energy.

208.DSCR:
One of the Three Great Gods of $$ミケーネ$$.
Known by the names 'King of Hell' and 'King of the Underworld,' he rules over the land of the dead.
He wields the power of flame, fighting with a pair of greatswords wrapped in crimson hellfire.
$$甲児$$, $$つばさ$$, and $$あしゅら男爵$$ encountered him when they were sent into ancient $$ミケーネ$$, the world of $$ケドラ$$'s memories.
He conspired with $$ゴーゴン大公$$ to eliminate $$ゼウス神#pilot$$, his fellow member of the Three Great Gods of $$ミケーネ$$, but was defeated by the combined efforts of $$マジンガーＺ$$ and $$ゼウス神#pilot$$. However, as he lay dying, he declared he would return as the Dark Emperor, and vanished into the flames.

209.DSCR:
A Mechanical God of $$ミケーネ$$.
It is called 'Hero' for its valor.
After the passage of many years, its body was split into the $$機械獣$$s $$ガラダＫ７$$ and $$ダブラスＭ２$$.
$$甲児$$, $$つばさ$$, and $$あしゅら男爵$$ encountered it when they were sent into ancient $$ミケーネ$$, the world of $$ケドラ$$'s memories. It fought $$マジンガーＺ$$ and was defeated by the Rust Hurricane.
Unlike ordinary $$機械獣$$s, it has a will of its own and is even able to speak.

215.DSCR:
The black Megadeus piloted by $$ロジャー・スミス$$.
When $$ロジャー$$ shouts '$$ビッグオー$$, Showtime!' into the wristwatch on his left arm, it emerges from underground to face the enemy alongside him.
When $$ロジャー$$ boards, the front monitor displays the inscription 'CAST IN THE NAME OF GOD YE NOT GUILTY' (I cast this in the name of God; you are not guilty).
It is normally stored beneath $$ロジャー$$'s mansion. But once summoned by $$ロジャー$$, it races to its destination through disused underground transit tunnels aboard its dedicated transporter, the '$$プレイリードッグ$$.'
It conceals built-in weapons such as the eye-mounted beam 'Arc Line' and the 'Cannon Party' and 'Missile Party' fired from its chest and abdomen, but its ultimate finishing move is 'Sudden Impact,' a one-hit-kill strike delivered by driving its arm's Strike Pile into the enemy.
Other weapons exist as well, and these were revealed over the course of its battles.
Like the other Bigs, it occasionally takes action of its own accord as though it has a will, and remains shrouded in mystery -- even its pilot, $$ロジャー$$, does not know when, where, or by whom it was built, or for what purpose.

217.DSCR:
An AS owned by the anti-terrorist organization $$ミスリル$$.
Sergeant $$相良宗介$$ is its designated operator (pilot).
A cutting-edge third-generation AS developed based on the M9. Its greatest feature is the black technology it carries, the 'Lambda Driver.' The Lambda Driver is a system that converts the pilot's aggressive impulses into physical force, allowing it to display power and mobility impossible for an ordinary AS. Of all the AS $$ミスリル$$ possesses, this is the only unit fitted with this system. However, because its activation is somewhat unreliable, $$宗介$$ initially considered it lacking in reliability as a weapon and felt an aversion toward it.
Its equipment follows $$ミスリル$$'s common specifications, allowing it to use the M9's gear as-is. Its main armaments are the Boxer shotgun and monomolecular cutter that $$宗介$$ favors, with two fixed chain guns and wire guns mounted on both arms. Its power source is a palladium reactor, with a maximum operational endurance of 100 hours.
Its AI's call sign is $$アル$$. It optimized itself to $$宗介$$ as its pilot the first time he boarded the $$アーバレスト$$. Afterward this setting cannot be changed, and no one but him can activate the Lambda Driver -- making it a machine of many mysteries.
It was initially deployed to the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ as an expensive experimental unit, but $$宗介$$ came to pilot it during the hijacking incident in the $$ハンカ自治州$$.
From then on, through many twists and turns, it fought through numerous fierce battles alongside him.

218.DSCR:
The $$アーバレスト$$ with its Lambda Driver activated.
It deploys the heat dissipation plates on both shoulders and its back, allowing it to cool itself efficiently.
The Lambda Driver consumes a large amount of power, and the units related to it occupy the machine's internal volume, so its operating time is shorter than that of the M9.

219.DSCR:
An AS equipped with the Lambda Driver, piloted by $$宗介$$, that is the successor to the $$アーバレスト$$.
Its AI is the same '$$アル$$' carried over from the $$アーバレスト$$.
It boasts overwhelming machine performance, able to leap nearly 80 m and to spin an enemy AS a full turn with a mere leg sweep.
It also carries an exclusive armament, the 165mm multipurpose fragmentation howitzer 'Demolition Gun,' and has two AI-operated auxiliary arms to handle the varied weapons mounted on its various parts.
However, as a trade-off for that performance, its operating time is extremely short: 30 hours, compared to the $$アーバレスト$$'s 100 hours.
It also carries no $$ＥＣＳ$$, and has only the bare minimum of other electronic weapons; in $$アル$$'s words, 'barely better than an M6.'
Incidentally, the original ARX-8 was discarded partway through construction; $$アル$$ redesigned it as a new body for itself, and it was completed with the cooperation of $$ミラ$$, one of the $$ウィスパード$$.

220.DSCR:
$$レーバテイン$$ equipped with the Emergency Deployment Booster XL-3.
The Emergency Deployment Booster XL-3 can carry $$レーバテイン$$ fully equipped with armaments including the $$妖精の羽$$, and was used in the landing operation on $$メリダ島$$.
The booster is equipped with 'Black Mamba' anti-air missiles, and in the landing operation it wiped out a large number of attack helicopters.
220.DSC2:
$$レーバテイン$$ equipped with the Emergency Deployment Booster XL-3.

The booster is equipped with 'Black Mamba' anti-air missiles, and in the landing operation it wiped out a large number of attack helicopters.
Note that the 'XL-3' equipment did not originally exist. It is a name given for convenience by its creator, $$サックス$$, to two XL-2 Emergency Deployment Boosters that were forcibly connected together.

221.DSCR:
A cutting-edge third-generation AS.
It is operated by $$ミスリル$$, and this unit is piloted by Sergeant Major $$メリッサ・マオ$$.
This model is said to still be under development by the US military, and has not yet been deployed to any organization or nation other than $$ミスリル$$. As $$ミスリル$$'s main weapon, machines of the E series are operated by $$ＳＲＴ$$ personnel.
Compared to existing machines it boasts extremely high performance, and its high mobility and stealth in particular overwhelm other AS. Its $$ＥＣＳ$$ not only neutralizes electronic weapons such as sensors and radar, but also renders it invisible to the naked eye.
The greatest feature of $$マオ$$'s unit is the composite blade antenna mounted on its head unit, which enhances its sensor capabilities. This grants it the electronic warfare capability required of a frontline command unit. The high-altitude data-link device 'ITCC-5 (Integrated Tactical Communication Control System)' enables it to integrate, manage, and analyze the vast amounts of data on the battlefield.
Its main armaments are a 40mm assault rifle and a monomolecular cutter.

222.DSCR:
A cutting-edge third-generation AS.
It is operated by $$ミスリル$$, and this unit is piloted by Sergeant $$クルツ・ウェーバー$$.
This model is said to still be under development by the US military, and has not yet been deployed to any organization or nation other than $$ミスリル$$. As $$ミスリル$$'s main weapon, machines of the E series are operated by $$ＳＲＴ$$ personnel.

Its $$ＥＣＳ$$ not only neutralizes electronic weapons such as sensors and radar, but also renders it invisible to the naked eye. This performance was also put to use when it operated through the city streets on a mission to guard $$かなめ$$.
$$クルツ$$'s unit is most distinguished by its 57mm smoothbore gun. It is normally folded and mounted on the back, but is deployed for use, and the unit snipes from positions such as a prone firing posture, using the bipod beneath the barrel.

223.DSCR:
A D-series prototype of the M9 possessed by $$ミスリル$$.
It is a machine that was transferred to the $$西太平洋戦隊$$ from the $$地中海戦隊$$ together with $$クルーゾー$$.
It is a Western-developed third-generation AS, and while its basic performance does not differ from the mass-produced E-series machines, its coloring has been changed to black, and armor has been added to its upper body.
$$クルーゾー$$'s unit is also equipped with the high-altitude data-link device 'ITCC-5 (Integrated Tactical Communication Control System),' giving it functions as a command unit as well.
Its main armaments are a 40mm assault rifle and the Crimson Edge monomolecular cutter.
It rescued $$宗介$$ and the others while they were being pursued on Sicily, and afterward, in a mock battle shortly after the transfer, $$クルーゾー$$'s combat sense and piloting skill overwhelmed $$宗介$$'s $$アーバレスト$$.

In the final battle, it released the limiter on its palladium reactor and defeated $$ファウラー$$'s $$エリゴール$$, but was heavily damaged and ended its service.

224.DSCR:
The machine $$宗介$$ piloted in the AS arena in $$ナムサク$$ after losing the $$アーバレスト$$.
Its ring name is 'Crossbow,' the same as the name of the team it belongs to, but when it was painted in the same coloring as the $$アーバレスト$$, $$宗介$$ called it '$$アル$$ II.'
It is originally an early-model $$サベージ$$ with a diesel engine, but $$ナミ$$ made special modifications to its control system, and various parts have been reinforced.

229.DSCR:
A third-generation AS currently under trial by the Eastern bloc.
It carries the same palladium reactor as the M9, the West's next-generation main AS, and its basic performance rivals the M9's, though it lags behind in electronic weaponry.
Its main armaments are an assault rifle and a monomolecular cutter, with a wire gun as a fixed weapon.
The secret organization $$アマルガム$$ also operates it, and custom units exist as well.

Its main armaments are an assault rifle and a monomolecular cutter, with a wire gun as a fixed weapon.
The secret organization $$アマルガム$$ also operates it, and custom units exist as well.
In the final battle with $$アマルガム$$, the resurrected $$クルツ$$ piloted a sniper-spec custom unit based on this machine, with additions such as a shooting visor.

230.DSCR:
An AS operated by the secret organization $$アマルガム$$, piloted by $$ゲイツ$$.
It is characterized by its red coloring, and is called '$$ヴェノム$$' by $$ミスリル$$.
It is a machine of the same lineage as the $$コダール$$, but has had improvements added to each part, giving it a different design starting with its head.
Its main armaments are a machine gun and the Dark Edge monomolecular cutter.
$$ゲイツ$$ effortlessly masters the installed Lambda Driver to fight against $$ミスリル$$. In the incident at the Yangtze River Crossing Tunnel, he engaged $$宗介$$'s $$アーバレスト$$ in combat. He overwhelmed the $$アーバレスト$$, whose Lambda Driver activation was unstable, but his own machine overheated and he withdrew. In Hong Kong, he led a squadron of mass-production units against $$ミスリル$$'s $$ＳＲＴ$$ (Special Response Team), driving them into a corner. However, when the $$アーバレスト$$ arrived to their rescue, the tide of battle turned completely. Struck by a blow from $$宗介$$'s Lambda Driver, wielded now that he had cast aside his doubts, it exploded and was destroyed.

231.DSCR:
An AS operated by the secret organization $$アマルガム$$.
Under $$ミスリル$$'s classification code, it is designated a '$$ヴェノム$$' type machine.
It is said to have been developed based on the Eastern-made third-generation AS, the $$Ｚｙ－９８$$, but its greatest feature is that it carries a Lambda Driver. This allows it to display combat power surpassing the M9, which is likewise a third-generation AS.
Its main armaments are a 35mm rifle and the Dark Edge monomolecular cutter.
In Hong Kong it appeared alongside $$ゲイツ$$' unit, driving $$ミスリル$$'s $$ＳＲＴ$$ (Special Response Team) into a corner. However, when the $$アーバレスト$$ piloted by $$宗介$$ arrived to their rescue, the tide of battle turned completely, and its units were destroyed one after another.

232.DSCR:
A super-giant AS possessed by the terrorist group '$$Ａ２１$$.'
Its pilot is $$クガヤマ・タクマ$$.
It is so massive that it cannot even support its own weight without activating its Lambda Driver.
Its main armaments are a giant sword and a 30mm autocannon mounted on its head.
Hidden aboard a cargo ship, it was activated by $$タクマ$$, who crushed the JGSDF's $$習志野強襲機兵中隊$$ deployed to suppress it, and attempted to destroy the entire Tokyo Bay area. In the end, it faced off against the $$アーバレスト$$ piloted by $$宗介$$, which destroyed the cooling unit at the base of its leg and shut down the function of its Lambda Driver. As a result, unable to support its own weight, it collapsed.
232.DSC2:
A super-giant AS possessed by the terrorist group '$$Ａ２１$$.'
Its pilot is $$クガヤマ・タクマ$$.
It is so massive that it cannot even support its own weight without activating its Lambda Driver.
Its main armaments are a giant sword and a 30mm autocannon mounted on its head.

As a result, unable to support its own weight, it collapsed.
It was later mass-produced by $$アマルガム$$ and drove $$ミスリル$$ into a corner.
Multiple units attacked $$宗介$$, but they were destroyed before the power of $$レーバテイン$$ and the $$妖精の羽$$.

233.DSCR:
An AS equipped with the Lambda Driver, operated by $$アマルガム$$. Effectively $$レナード$$'s personal machine.
It is said that with $$レナード$$, a $$ウィスパード$$, aboard, it can draw out the full power of the Lambda Driver, and it can keep the Lambda Driver activated for long periods.
Its performance is so high that it is called 'the strongest machine in the world,' and, used together with the Lambda Driver, it boasts mobility beyond common sense.
It also has wings that make use of the Lambda Driver, and can fly on its own.
233.DSC2:
An AS equipped with the Lambda Driver, operated by $$アマルガム$$. Effectively $$レナード$$'s personal machine.
It is said that with $$レナード$$, a $$ウィスパード$$, aboard, it can draw out the full power of the Lambda Driver, and it can keep the Lambda Driver activated for long periods.
Its performance is so high that it is called 'the strongest machine in the world,' and, used together with the Lambda Driver, it boasts mobility beyond common sense; on its first appearance, it wrecked $$宗介$$'s $$アーバレスト$$ with nothing but a hand chop.
It also has wings that make use of the Lambda Driver, and can fly on its own.
Later, it was equipped with the Isaian Bone Bow, which fires the invisible force field of the Lambda Driver as energy bullets.
Because it uses tactics that rely on the Lambda Driver, when the Lambda Driver canceller, the '$$妖精の羽$$,' was used on it by $$レーバテイン$$, it crashed and took damage.

234.DSCR:
The mascot character of the amusement park '$$ふもふもランド$$'... modified by $$宗介$$.
It is generally called a costume, but in reality it can be called a small-scale AS, equipped internally with all sorts of machinery.
Its armaments are varied, including a grenade launcher, a special baton, and hand grenades.
Its distinguishing external feature is the cross-shaped scar on its left cheek, matching $$宗介$$'s own.
It is also fitted with the voice-changer function originally built into the costume, and for some reason, all of its functions stop working if this is turned off. Because of this, the function must always be kept on, and as a result, no matter what it says, it comes out externally as words resembling 'fumoffu!' $$かなめ$$, however, can understand its meaning and interpret for it.
With agility that its round body would never suggest, along with its firearms, it takes down villains and the like.
$$宗介$$ mass-produced them and sold them as equipment for the military and police, but perhaps because of their appearance, sales did not grow, and apart from those bought by the FBI and the Miami Police Department, they went unsold, leaving $$宗介$$ in debt.
Incidentally, news footage afterward showed the Miami police using it to good effect.

235.DSCR:
A Mechanical $$天翅$$ that $$アポロニアス#pilot$$ built 12,000 years ago to fight the $$堕天翅$$. It is sometimes called the Mythical-type $$アクエリオン$$.
By combining three Vector Machines, it can take three different forms. Depending on the order of composition, the completed form and its abilities change greatly. This is the strongest form of $$アクエリオン$$, completed with Vector Sol forming the upper body, Vector Mars the lower body, and $$ベクタールナ$$ the back.
It is characterized by a red-based color scheme and a head modeled on the sun, and power stones that amplify bio-energy and higher-dimensional quantum power are located on both shoulders and both shins.
While it has armor resistant to physical attacks and enormous output, its pilot is also required to have tremendous $$エレメント$$ ability, so it has become a form used almost exclusively by $$アポロ$$. Deploying the Solar Wings on its back allows it to display even greater power.
Its main armament is its 'fists' themselves, and their destructive power is so great that it can smash a $$ケルビム兵$$ in a single blow even without using any particular technique. Its finishing moves, such as the 'Infinite Punch,' a life-risking punch that reaches all the way to the moon, and the 'Light-Shadow Unity Fist,' unleashed in unison by $$アポロ$$ and $$シルヴィア$$ after they realized each other's true feelings, are again mostly fist-based.
Incidentally, only when $$リーナ$$ pilots it as the main pilot does it become the 'Silver $$アクエリオン$$,' which shines silver.
At first, $$アポロ$$, who carries the past life of $$アポロニアス#pilot$$, was thought to be the 'Wings of the Sun,' the savior. But it was revealed by $$頭翅#pilot$$ that the $$アクエリオン$$ that $$アポロニアス#pilot$$ built using his own wings was the true 'Wings of the Sun.'

236.DSCR:
A $$ケルビム兵$$ that appeared in Episode 21, 'The Crimson Road.'
Befitting a machine piloted by $$頭翅#pilot$$, the front-line commander of the $$堕天翅$$, its combat ability is among the strongest class of $$ケルビム兵$$.
It deftly wielded the swords on both arms and toyed with $$シリウス$$'s $$アクエリオンマーズ$$. And during that fight, $$シリウス$$ was captivated and defected to the $$堕天翅$$ tribe.

237.DSCR:
A Mechanical $$天翅$$ owned by $$ネオディーヴァ$$.
It is an Assault-type $$アクエリオン$$ that was used in the battle against the $$堕天翅$$ 12,000 years ago, excavated and then refitted.
It is completed when three fighter craft called Vector Machines combine.
Depending on the combination, it can form three different configurations, each with a greatly different fighting style and appearance.
Its pilots are boys and girls with superhuman abilities called $$エレメント$$ users. Their power is required for the combination, and the combined unit's specs are also heavily affected by their abilities and mental state.
In $$アクエリオンＥＶＯＬ#robot$$, $$ベクターゼド$$ forms the upper body, Vector X the lower body, and Vector Siron the back.
This form is easily influenced by its pilots' $$エレメント$$ abilities, but of the three configurations it can produce the greatest power.
It closely resembles the Mythical-type $$アクエリオン$$ of the legend from 12,000 years ago, sharing common points such as a red-based color scheme and Solar Wings mounted on its back.
It had been sealed away because male-female combination was forbidden, but it awakened when $$アマタ$$ and $$ミコノ$$ boarded it.

239.DSCR:
A Mechanical Angel owned by $$ネオディーヴァ$$.
It is completed when three fighter craft called Vector Machines combine.
Depending on the combination, it can form three different configurations, each with a greatly different fighting style and appearance.
Its pilots are boys and girls with superhuman abilities called $$エレメント$$ users. Their power is required for the combination, and the combined unit's specs are also heavily affected by their abilities and mental state.
In $$アクエリオンスパーダ$$, $$ベクターシロン$$ forms the upper body, $$ベクターゼド$$ the lower body, and Vector X the back.
It comes standard with an Energy Sword in its right hand and a shield in its left.
It boasts a movement speed that exceeds the speed of sound, and excels at high-speed combat that makes use of that speed.
Operating it requires high $$エレメント$$ ability, as well as the skill to fully handle a high-speed unit, making it the configuration that demands the most from its pilot's own ability.
It is mainly piloted by $$シュレード$$.
In the final battle, $$カイエン$$ piloted it. $$カイエン$$ sensed the melody of the soul that $$シュレード$$ had left behind, brought forth a new configuration, $$アクエリオンゲパーダ$$, and fought $$ミカゲ$$.

240.DSCR:
A mid-size, mass-produced, multipurpose Mythical Beast.
It is a spider-shaped, self-piloting drone, though it can also be remote-controlled. It is also equipped with a cockpit, allowing manned piloting when necessary.
This type is a combat model, but many other variants exist, the abduction model being a representative example.
It flies freely using a gravity-control engine, and moves on the ground using its four legs.
On $$アルテア$$ it is a machine produced in large numbers and nothing special, but to an Earth lagging behind in science and weapons technology, it poses a considerable threat.

242.DSCR:
A humanoid weapon sent by $$ミカゲ$$.
It is highly agile, toying with its enemies through unpredictable movement.
It is characterized by long limbs and sharp claws, and can summon a blizzard.
It closely resembles the $$ケルビム・リュンヌ$$ used by the $$堕天翅$$ in the battle 12,000 years ago.

246.DSCR:
The symbolic Gunmen of $$大グレン団$$, which defeated the $$螺旋王$$ and saved humanity.
It is completed when $$グレン$$ and $$ラガン$$ combine, producing a power where one plus one equals more than two. It also boasts astonishing defensive performance thanks to features such as a regeneration ability that instantly restores $$グレン$$ and $$ラガン$$ no matter how damaged they are, and a special energy field covering its surface.
Every attack is carried out with its drills. The freely extending and retracting drills can be used not only to pierce directly, but also to generate tornadoes using their rotational force, or to crack open the ground by driving them in.
After the new government was established, $$シモン$$ piloted it alone, but eventually his old rival $$ヴィラル$$ came to ride in the cockpit of $$グレン$$, pulling off a 'Fated Combination' that intertwined the two paths of man and beast.
It further combined with $$アークグレン$$, which had been hidden beneath $$カミナシティ$$, giving birth to $$アークグレンラガン$$, and that $$アークグレンラガン$$ then became the core of $$超銀河ダイグレン$$, giving birth to $$超銀河グレンラガン$$. $$超銀河グレンラガン$$ then broke through the heavens to become $$天元突破グレンラガン#robot$$, and $$天元突破グレンラガン#robot$$ in turn became $$超天元突破グレンラガン$$.
In this way, centered on the Core Drill held by $$シモン$$ and on $$ラガン$$, $$グレンラガン$$ underwent what could be called limitless growth and evolution.

249.DSCR:
The ultimate Gunmen, one that breaks through both the heavens and dimensions itself.
It was born in the Spiral Universe, where perception becomes reality, when all the surviving members of $$大グレン団$$ became core drills and spun on together.
It boasts a scale so vast that it can hurl entire galaxies and use them as footholds.
Each of the face-like parts visible across its body carries a pilot. Each person materialized weapons of their specialty one after another -- rifles, swords, anchors -- and waged the final battle against $$グランゼボーマ$$.
During the battle, though driven into a corner, it achieved Super Tengen Toppa and defeated $$グランゼボーマ$$.

258.DSCR:
The $$汎用ヒト型決戦兵器　人造人間エヴァンゲリオン　試験初号機$$.
The EVA series is humanity's only weapon capable of opposing the Angels, and $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ branches around the world are pouring vast sums of money into its development and construction.
Its greatest characteristic is its ability to deploy an A.T. Field. 'A.T.' stands for 'Absolute Terror,' referring to the absolutely inviolable territory the Angels deploy. By having the same ability, an EVA can erode its opponent's field, making it possible for the first time to attack the core and other targets.
Its main power is electricity supplied through the umbilical cable on its back. If the cable is severed, it switches to its internal power source, but reaches its activity limit within five minutes.
Unit-01's main armaments include the Progressive Knife for close combat, a large-caliber 209mm rifle, and a portable rotary multi-barrel 440mm cannon.
In the battle against $$第９の使徒$$, by switching control over to the Dummy System, it fought with overwhelming power beyond its usual output and thoroughly destroyed $$ＥＶＡ３号機$$, which had become $$第９の使徒$$.

Deliberate changes to Jigoku wording: 179 'forced reconnaissance' -> 'reconnaissance in force' (強行偵察); 209 Jigoku had 'the $$ブレイヴ$$ One' for 勇者 (Brave is an unrelated unit token) -> 'called Hero', matching the official 'Hero Garadoublas'; 215 inscription written without the comma after GOD (source has none); 223 'shortly after his transfer' -> 'shortly after the transfer' (no gender for the pilot in the Japanese); 229/230/231/232/233 Tengoku sentences that changed from Jigoku (machine gun instead of 35mm rifle, Amalgam instead of 'organizations hostile to Mithril', '西側の' dropped before M9 in 231) were re-translated; 237 'excavated from the Assault-type Aquarion' (Jigoku) -> 'an Assault-type Aquarion ... excavated and refitted' (発掘し、改修したもの); 237 'Mythical Aquarion' -> 'Mythical-type Aquarion' to match 235; 235 says 12,000 years ago (Jigoku entry said 24,000).

Gender: kept he/his for Zeus, Hades and Hero Garadoublas (207-209) only because Jigoku used it for these known characters (the Japanese has no pronoun); he/his also for Roger, Sousuke, Gates (230) and Simon (246), as in Jigoku. Pronouns avoided for Clouseau (223, 'the transfer'), Leonard, Apollonius, Sirius, Rina and Cayenne (239: 'Cayenne sensed...' instead of Jigoku 'he').

Aquarion: リーナ (235) is proposed as 'Reena' with no wiki evidence. 頭翅 and アポロニアス used the #pilot tokens (both are characters here; kw_070 uses the keyword token). 無限拳（むげんパンチ） and 光影合一拳（こうえいごういつけん） translated by meaning ('Infinite Punch', 'Light-Shadow Unity Fist') because the parenthesized readings are furigana; official English may be romanized Mugen Punch / Koei Goitsu Ken. Jigoku spelled ルナ 'Ruuna' and リュンヌ 'Ruune'; I used 'Vector Luna' and 'Cherubim Lune' (names entry) - the Vector Machines stay literal. 235 DSC2 differs from DSCR only by a hard-wrap in the Japanese, so the DSC2 English is identical to DSCR. アクエリオンゲパーダ (239) differs from glossary アクエリオンゲパルト ('Aquarion Gepard'); likely the same unit, proposed 'Aquarion Geparda' as in Jigoku. 太陽の翼 written 'Wings of the Sun'. 236: episode title 紅い道 as 'The Crimson Road'; 堕天翅族 as 'Fallen Wing tribe'.

Evangelion 258: 第１０の使徒 glossary English is '10th Angel' (no 'the'), unlike 第９の使徒 'the Ninth Angel'; I wrote 'the $$第１０の使徒$$' - fix whichever way the sheet settles. 疑似シン化第１形態 -> 'Pseudo-Shinka First Form' (no source). 258 first sentence uses the glossary token (Jigoku did the same) although the Japanese has a middle dot instead of a space in the string.

Full Metal Panic: 妖精の羽 -> 'Fairy Wings', 妖精の目 -> 'Fairy Eye' (both only my transliteration); ナムサク -> 'Namsac' (from series knowledge, not in project sources); エリゴール -> 'Eligor', サックス -> 'Sax' unverified. アイザイアン・ボーン・ボウ written 'Isaian Bone Bow' (transliteration, may be 'Isaiah Bone Bow' officially). 'Al II' for アル二世. 224 DSC2: 'an M9 and ten second-generation AS' assumes 10機 belongs to the second-generation AS only; 'discharge' for 「除隊」を許可 (the machine is discharged by Sousuke). 222 DSC2: the subject of 頼りきりであった is omitted in Japanese; written passively ('had to be relied upon entirely'). 234: 市警 as 'Miami Police Department' then 'Miami police'.

Macross Frontier 186: ギャラクシー船団幹部のユニット translated 'the unit of the Galaxy Fleet executive' (singular assumed; the Japanese could be plural) using the ギャラクシー船団 keyword token rather than the ギャラクシー船団幹部 pilot token. 女王バジュラ is treated as one name, 'Queen Vajra', and referred to as 'it' since the source has no pronoun. 175-185 DSC2: 'actions have been taken over by implant bullets' / 'lodged in it' for インプラント弾により行動を支配された状態 / 撃ちこまれている; インプラント is a pending keyword token used as $$インプラント|lc$$. 177 keeps Jigoku 'swarm' for 集団 while 183/185 use 'group'.

Getter 196: 真ゲッター in 'the power of Shin Getter and Shin Getter Dragon' is tokenized as a new unit name 'Shin Getter' (which of Shin Getter 1/2/3 is meant is not settled). ゲッター太陽化 written 'turned into a Getter sun'.

Mazinger 197-209: 'Three Great Gods of Mycenae' (ミケーネ三大神), 'Dark Emperor' (闇の帝王) and 'Arm of Zeus' (ゼウスの腕, using the bare ゼウス pilot token) kept from Jigoku. 207/208 use ゼウス神#pilot / ハーデス pilot tokens (not the #robot ones) because the text refers to the characters.
